parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the node group in the hybrid cloud cluster.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: Mids
parameters.description: The ID of the node that you want to add to the node group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Resource Manager resource group.
